lines.trans: Could you tell me where to find the bartender?
Who goes to bars in the morning?
Not at all, I came to see my son.
He works here as a bartender.
Ah, well here is our Konstantin.
Chef, what else do you want from me?
Kostya, you and I did not finish talking.
You and I have already said everything.
Children are like a favorite soccer team.
You always worry a lot about them.
And in return you get complete disappointment.

examples.text: Нет, я уже своё слово сказал.
examples.trans: No, I have already given my word.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian conversational adverb meaning 'here', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Да нет, Костя тут не виноват.
examples.trans: No, Kostya is not at fault here.

examples.text: Вы меня тут за глупца держите?
examples.trans: Do you take me for a fool here?

examples.text: Хватит тут громко плакать и кричать.
examples.trans: Stop crying and shouting loudly in here.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('at fault, guilty').

examples.text: Да нет, Костя тут не виноват.
examples.trans: No, Kostya is not at fault here.

examples.text: Это ты виноват!
examples.trans: It's your fault!

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'this, it (is)', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мне надо хорошо подумать об этом.
examples.trans: I need to think carefully about this.

examples.text: Это мне сегодня Настя рассказала.
examples.trans: Nastya told me this today.

examples.text: Ты так сильно расстроился из-за этого?
examples.trans: Did you get so upset because of this?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian discourse particle adding conversational nuance meaning 'only', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мне осталось только со Светой разобраться.
examples.trans: I only have left to sort things out with Sveta.

examples.text: Месть подают к столу только холодной.
examples.trans: Revenge is served to the table only cold.

examples.text: Надо только быстро отпилить большие рога.
examples.trans: We just need to quickly saw off the big antlers.

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian personal or demonstrative pronoun meaning 'my', inherited from Common Slavic roots and used constantly in natural spoken dialogue.

examples.text: Мой поезд уходит уже завтра утром.
examples.trans: My train leaves tomorrow morning already.

examples.text: Вот мой сын на меня обиделся.
examples.trans: So my son got offended at me.

examples.text: Мы отдали мой костюм в химчистку.
examples.trans: We gave my suit to the dry cleaners.

meanings.note: Common neuter noun meaning 'wine' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Да нет, Костя тут не виноват.
examples.trans: No, Kostya is not at fault here.

examples.text: Это только моя вина.
examples.trans: This is only my fault.

examples.text: Извините, я зашёл только быстро спросить.
examples.trans: Excuse me, I came in just to ask quickly.
